  PROBLEM: The hook command path is quoted as `"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh`, which these reviewers said prevents proper hook registration.

  WHY: Multiple reviewers reproduced wrong outputs such as `repo/pulls` or `tree/main`, while deepseek treated this as a theoretical edge rather than a practical bug.

  WHY: qwen and x-ai said the note is still misleading, while deepseek said the current text already enumerates multiple possible causes.
